'''Aine 22 (April 6)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[978 NE]] - [[Moiraine]] meets [[Lan]] personally for the first time. Lan throws Moiraine into a pond, in turn causing Moiraine to channel half the pond onto Lan.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Mat]] takes [[Tuon]] to a hell in [[Maderin]]. Their party is attacked by assassins in the street, but they manage to fight them off. Mat decides to leave [[Valan Luca]]'s show.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]] acquires a substantial amount of [[forkroot]] for an attack on the [[Shaido]]. He is wounded by an assassination attempt.
*[[1000 NE]] - The Goshien [[Aiel]], along with [[Aviendha]] leave [[Andor]] on [[Rand]]'s orders.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Reanne Corly]] is found dead, smothered with the [[One Power]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Loial]] and [[Erith]] become married. Loial then speaks out his opposition over opening the [[Book of Translation]].
*[[1000 NE]] - An army of [[Trollocs]] and [[Myrddraal]] attack the manor where Rand is based.
*[[1000 NE]] [[Nynaeve]] takes [[Lan]] to [[World's End]] in [[Saldaea]] to begin riding to [[Malkier]] and rally troops in the process.
